checkedAlternates.risk: The cell nucleus has a double-membrane envelope.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The nucleolus is a dense RNA-protein sub-compartment without its own membrane (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Peroxisomes perform oxidation reactions like mitochondria.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Peroxisomes are bounded by a single lipid bilayer (group-4), unlike double-membrane mitochondria (group-2).
